text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In a strategy meeting for next year, 
Curren Chan introduces star Umamusume from 
across the social media world.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Biko Pegasus, the tokusatsu-themed 
UmaTokker. Hishi Akebono, the 
cooking-themed UmaStagrammer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Taiki Shuttle, the slice-of-life Umatuber. 
Sakura Bakushin O, the class-rep-style 
Class Rep.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Every last one of them was a sprinter. 
Determined to take them all on next year, 
Curren Chan began laying out her plans.
